summary: W. G. Emrich, Director of the Office of Environment and Design for the Regional Federal Highway Administration, formally approved and adopted the Final Environmental Impact Statement for the Airport Spur project on March 14, 1976. His approval signifies the FHWA's endorsement of the proposed 1.5-mile freeway-airport connection between I-94 and General Mitchell Field. No complaints or objections are attributed to him; his role is solely as the approving official.
complaint_summary: W. G. Emrich is identified solely as the approving FHWA official who formally adopted the Final Environmental Impact Statement on 3-14-76, expressing no complaint or objection.
